messages.text: How do changes in AI data centers technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

### Short answer
AI data center technology shifts the tester requirement toward broader connectivity validation—network emulation, RF/WLAN signaling, throughput/PER/BLER, IP/application analysis, latency/jitter impairment control, generative-AI user-experience KPIs, multi-radio desense, and non-signaling waveform/TX validation—while core AI server PCB, cable, optical, power-rail, and cooling-related measurements are mapped in the passages to VNA/phase-noise/oscilloscope/power tools rather than to a signaling tester [22][23][32][43][55][58][63].
### Technology change → required measurement capability
| AI data center / AI infrastructure change | Measurement capability impact for Signaling / Non-signaling Tester |
|---|---|
| AI data center infrastructure is framed around Connectivity, Power, and Resilience, and full-spectrum data center connectivity includes high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power distribution, busbar, liquid cooling, and leak detection [8][92]. | The signaling tester portion is most relevant where “connectivity” becomes wireless/network/application validation, while the passages map PCB, cable, optical, power-rail, and related hardware measurements to tools such as R&S ZNA/ZNB, R&S FSWP, MXO, and ZISO rather than to CMX500 [22][23][43][63]. |
| AI server boards and interconnects are moving toward 20+ layer UBB, high-end ABF, low-Dk CCL, 800G AOC, PCIe 6/7, InfiniBand 800Gbe, SiPh/CPO, higher GPU TDP, liquid cooling, HVDC, 5–10 kW PSU, liquid-cooled power cabinets, and BBU [5]. | These changes increase the need for IL, TDR, high-speed cable, optical VNA, jitter/phase-noise, LDO NSD, power-rail, multiphase DC, PI, and BMS-related measurements, but the cited mapping assigns those needs to ZNA/ZNB, FSWP, MXO, and ZISO rather than to a signaling/non-signaling tester [5][61][62][63]. |
| Wi‑Fi is moving toward Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn, where the cited source says the focus shifts from sheer speed to ultra-high reliability and introduces testing hurdles such as distributed resource units and unequal modulation [36]. | A signaling tester therefore needs next-generation WLAN RF signaling capability and PHY-feature validation such as dRU measurements and UEQM analysis; the cited source says Wi‑Fi 8 RF signaling tests were implemented on the R&S CMX500 one-box signaling tester and showcased with a Broadcom prototype WLAN device [36][37]. |
| Generative AI applications introduce user-experience metrics rather than only RF metrics, and the cited testbed uses CMX500 to configure network parameters, channel fading models, latency, jitter, and RF impairments while measuring Time to First Token and Tokens Per Second [41][43]. | A signaling tester used for AI application scenarios needs controlled network-condition emulation plus application-layer KPI measurement, including TTFT and TPS, not only RF parametric testing [41][42][43]. |
| Multi-technology devices can experience mutual interference when using more than one communication technology, and the cited UAV signaling note says CMX500 can support multi-technology de-sense validation across technologies such as LTE, 5G, and Wi‑Fi [28]. | The tester needs multi-technology, multi-channel signaling and desense capability to observe WLAN/LTE/NR interference effects under real connections [28][58]. |
| CMX500 features include NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, WLAN signaling and TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, PER measurement, application tests, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, and remote-control interfaces [22]. | The required signaling capability expands from “connect the DUT” to RF + protocol + traffic + application validation across cellular and WLAN technologies [22][23][32]. |
| The CMX500 non-signaling GPRF Generator use case supports ARB, CW, dual tone, replay `.wv` files, up to four GPRF Generator instances in parallel, waveform replay/creation, and standalone TX measurement workflows [55][56]. | The non-signaling side needs flexible waveform generation/replay and standalone TX measurement for R&D validation, while license and release-status caveats must be checked because the GPRF page is based on a callbox presentation rather than formal specifications [55][56][57]. |
### Bottom line
【推論】As AI data centers push higher-speed interconnect, optical connectivity, denser power, and liquid cooling, the tester portfolio must cover both infrastructure hardware measurements and wireless/application connectivity measurements, but the passages support CMX500-type signaling/non-signaling testers mainly for cellular/WLAN signaling, traffic/application testing, desense, Wi‑Fi 8 signaling, and GPRF waveform/TX workflows, not for the PCB/optical/power measurements mapped to ZNA/ZNB, FSWP, MXO, and ZISO [5][22][23][36][43][55][58][63].

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

CMX500 Callbox › Example Callbox use cases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。
- Sensitivity testing。
- [[RedCap]]。
- [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。
- [[3GPP Pre-Conformance Testing]]。
- [[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]]。
- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

Signaling test solution › 重點摘要
- 本來源是 OneNote 複製出的 [[UAV]] signaling test solution 筆記，raw 轉檔日期為 2026-09-17；正文未標示正式發布日期、作者、文件版次或適用客戶 / 專案。
- 來源指出無人機常使用多種通信技術，例子包含 proprietary radio / image transmission、Wi‑Fi、[[LTE]]、未來 [[5G]]、[[RTK]]、[[SATCOM]] 與 encrypted frequency-hopping radio。
- 來源以多款無人機 / UAV 產品為例整理核心通訊技術：[[DJI Mini 4 Pro]]、[[DJI Mavic 3]]、[[DJI Mavic 3 Enterprise]]、[[Parrot ANAFI Ai]]、[[XAG P100]]、[[Skydio X2E]]、[[RQ-4 Global Hawk]] 與 [[Switchblade]]。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] RF frequency range 為 **400 MHz 至 8 GHz**，可提供 [[LTE]]、[[5G]] 與 [[Wi-Fi]] UE 的單一技術 signaling test。
- 來源列出 signaling test 可包含基本 RF 量測、application layer tests 與 protocol test；基本 RF 量測項目包含 Power、Frequency、Spectrum、[[EVM]]、[[PER]] / [[BLER]]、[[MIMO]]。
- 來源列出一組 [[R&S CMX500]] 5G test configuration，包含 [[R&S CMX-PB70H]]、[[R&S CMX-B200A]]、[[R&S CMX-B300C]]、[[R&S CMX-B600B]]、[[R&S CMX-KA100]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KM600]]。
- 來源列出一組 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi test configuration，包含 WLAN signaling、WLAN TX measurement 與 WLAN ARB generator options，例如 [[R&S CMX-KS350B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS351B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS352B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS355B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS356B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS360B]]、[[R&S CMX-KM350]]、[[R&S CMX-KM351]]、[[R&S CMX-KM352]]、[[R&S CMX-KM360]]、[[R&S CMX-KW350]]、[[R&S CMX-KW351]]、[[R&S CMX-KW352]]。

Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests › 與 Wi-Fi 7 OTA 測試的區分
本頁不同於 [[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]]：

- [[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]] 目前由 Bluetest / EMITE OTA chamber PR 支撐，聚焦 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] over-the-air chamber workflow。
- [[Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests]] 目前由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] / [[Broadcom]] PR 支撐，聚焦 [[R&S CMX500]] signaling mode、[[Wi-Fi 8]] PHY features 與 prototype Broadcom WLAN device。

Generative AI user experience testing › 使用限制
- 本頁是 PR / demonstration-level evidence，不是正式 test specification、standardized benchmark 或 product datasheet。

Generative AI user experience testing
[[Generative AI user experience testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz and China Mobile Research Institute jointly demonstrate generative AI user experience testing]] 中描述的測試方法：在可控制的 wireless network conditions 下，以 [[Time to First Token]]、[[Tokens Per Second]] 等指標量化 generative AI application 的 end-user experience。

Generative AI user experience testing › 測試目的
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and China Mobile Research Institute jointly demonstrate generative AI user experience testing]]，industry still lacks mature metrics and standardized test frameworks for evaluating user experience of generative AI applications；[[3GPP]] 與 [[GTI]] 等組織正在進行 related research。

本來源中的 testbed 目標是：

- 在 diverse wireless environments 下量化 end-user experience。
- 比較不同 network conditions 對 generative AI application response 的影響。
- 支援 on-device generative AI application design optimization。
- 為 future network optimization 提供 reference points。
- 支援 [[6G-enabled AI technologies]] 的 evolution、validation and standardization。

Rohde & Schwarz and China Mobile Research Institute jointly demonstrate generative AI user experience testing › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[China Mobile Research Institute]] 在 [[MWC Shanghai 2026]] 展示一套 generative AI applications 測試 solution。
- 來源稱此 solution based on the [[R&S CMX500]] 5G one-box signaling tester，可在 diverse network conditions 下首次量化 measurement end-user experience of generative AI applications。
- 測試架構中：
  - [[Large language model]] 部署在 server side 或 cloud。
  - [[R&S CMX500]] 與執行 client-side test application 的 smart terminal 建立 radio connection。
  - [[R&S CMX500]] 可配置 network parameters、channel fading models、latency、jitter、RF impairments 等 variables。
  - 使用者透過 terminal-side application 輸入 prompts，接收 LLM inference responses。
  - Host PC software 收集與分析 data，並產生 charts。
- 來源列出的 key performance indicators 包含 [[Time to First Token]]（TTFT）與 [[Tokens Per Second]]（TPS）。
- 來源稱此方法可支援 optimization of on-device generative AI application design，並提供 future network optimization 的 reference points。
- 來源把 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 all-in-one test platform，支援 SA / NSA architectures、FR1 to FR3（up to 18 GHz）、built-in IMS server、RF conformance、protocol validation、VoNR acoustics 與 carrier aggregation。
- [[Liu Guangyi]] 的引述把此 testbed 連到 6G-enabled ubiquitous intelligent connectivity、native network computing capabilities、new AI service metrics 與 testing methodologies。
- [[Jin Hailiang]] 的引述把此 testbed 描述為 generative AI user experience testing 的 benchmark，並指向 future test scenarios、industry use cases 與 standardization。
- 展示地點：China Mobile’s 6G Zone，Hall 3，N3E60。
- Press & media contact：[[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement。

### Short answer
AI data center technology shifts the tester requirement toward broader connectivity validation—network emulation, RF/WLAN signaling, throughput/PER/BLER, IP/application analysis, latency/jitter impairment control, generative-AI user-experience KPIs, multi-radio desense, and non-signaling waveform/TX validation—while core AI server PCB, cable, optical, power-rail, and cooling-related measurements are mapped in the passages to VNA/phase-noise/oscilloscope/power tools rather than to a signaling tester [22][23][32][43][55][58][63].
### Technology change → required measurement capability
| AI data center / AI infrastructure change | Measurement capability impact for Signaling / Non-signaling Tester |
|---|---|
| AI data center infrastructure is framed around Connectivity, Power, and Resilience, and full-spectrum data center connectivity includes high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power distribution, busbar, liquid cooling, and leak detection [8][92]. | The signaling tester portion is most relevant where “connectivity” becomes wireless/network/application validation, while the passages map PCB, cable, optical, power-rail, and related hardware measurements to tools such as R&S ZNA/ZNB, R&S FSWP, MXO, and ZISO rather than to CMX500 [22][23][43][63]. |
| AI server boards and interconnects are moving toward 20+ layer UBB, high-end ABF, low-Dk CCL, 800G AOC, PCIe 6/7, InfiniBand 800Gbe, SiPh/CPO, higher GPU TDP, liquid cooling, HVDC, 5–10 kW PSU, liquid-cooled power cabinets, and BBU [5]. | These changes increase the need for IL, TDR, high-speed cable, optical VNA, jitter/phase-noise, LDO NSD, power-rail, multiphase DC, PI, and BMS-related measurements, but the cited mapping assigns those needs to ZNA/ZNB, FSWP, MXO, and ZISO rather than to a signaling/non-signaling tester [5][61][62][63]. |
| Wi‑Fi is moving toward Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn, where the cited source says the focus shifts from sheer speed to ultra-high reliability and introduces testing hurdles such as distributed resource units and unequal modulation [36]. | A signaling tester therefore needs next-generation WLAN RF signaling capability and PHY-feature validation such as dRU measurements and UEQM analysis; the cited source says Wi‑Fi 8 RF signaling tests were implemented on the R&S CMX500 one-box signaling tester and showcased with a Broadcom prototype WLAN device [36][37]. |
| Generative AI applications introduce user-experience metrics rather than only RF metrics, and the cited testbed uses CMX500 to configure network parameters, channel fading models, latency, jitter, and RF impairments while measuring Time to First Token and Tokens Per Second [41][43]. | A signaling tester used for AI application scenarios needs controlled network-condition emulation plus application-layer KPI measurement, including TTFT and TPS, not only RF parametric testing [41][42][43]. |
| Multi-technology devices can experience mutual interference when using more than one communication technology, and the cited UAV signaling note says CMX500 can support multi-technology de-sense validation across technologies such as LTE, 5G, and Wi‑Fi [28]. | The tester needs multi-technology, multi-channel signaling and desense capability to observe WLAN/LTE/NR interference effects under real connections [28][58]. |
| CMX500 features include NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, WLAN signaling and TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, PER measurement, application tests, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, and remote-control interfaces [22]. | The required signaling capability expands from “connect the DUT” to RF + protocol + traffic + application validation across cellular and WLAN technologies [22][23][32]. |
| The CMX500 non-signaling GPRF Generator use case supports ARB, CW, dual tone, replay `.wv` files, up to four GPRF Generator instances in parallel, waveform replay/creation, and standalone TX measurement workflows [55][56]. | The non-signaling side needs flexible waveform generation/replay and standalone TX measurement for R&D validation, while license and release-status caveats must be checked because the GPRF page is based on a callbox presentation rather than formal specifications [55][56][57]. |
### Bottom line
【推論】As AI data centers push higher-speed interconnect, optical connectivity, denser power, and liquid cooling, the tester portfolio must cover both infrastructure hardware measurements and wireless/application connectivity measurements, but the passages support CMX500-type signaling/non-signaling testers mainly for cellular/WLAN signaling, traffic/application testing, desense, Wi‑Fi 8 signaling, and GPRF waveform/TX workflows, not for the PCB/optical/power measurements mapped to ZNA/ZNB, FSWP, MXO, and ZISO [5][22][23][36][43][55][58][63].
